decisions.reason: As a newly launched extension of the core offer with its own page, it likely remains above or near aspiration and the firm has enough slack to continue learning from the market.
This gas-tariff comparison product is close to existing capabilities and visibly marketed, so management would likely tolerate short-run uncertainty rather than reallocate resources immediately.
A regional electricity tariff calculator fits the firm’s established customer problems and platform direction, making continued support more likely than early withdrawal.

Although only mentioned on the website and more exposed to portfolio rationalisation across its several models, it still builds on core capabilities and would likely be retained while results are still forming.
The area-definition tool supports the surrounding tariff and market-process solutions, so even if demand is still emerging it is likely to be kept as a complementary module.

This comparison product faces the highest risk because it is only lightly presented and may overlap with nearby offerings, but its close fit with the core business still makes retention slightly more likely than exit.
